text:
maya: hey all, opening my first PR — quick sanity check: what's our branch pattern, commit msg style, and who to ping for fast reviews? also any special rules for DB migrations or generated code?
carlos: welcome! branch format: `feature/ENG-9999-short-desc` or `fix/ENG-9999-short-desc`. kebab-case after the ticket. keep it under ~50 chars.
anya: commit subject should be concise and conventional-ish: `feat(runtime): add cache ttl` or `fix(api): validate headers`. include ticket id in the body if not in the subject.
maya: CI sometimes flakes for me on integration jobs. how do I rerun?
devops-bot: [ci] Build queued for commit de9f1b2 1: lint pending, tests pending
carlos: to retrigger CI you can push an empty commit: `git commit --allow-empty -m "ci: retrigger" && git push`. Or use the CI UI "re-run". If it keeps failing, mention it in PR description.
anya: about DB migrations: include a migration plan in the PR description, and tag `@infra-db` for review. Large migrations need a rollout plan and runtime toggles; coordinate with infra early.
maya: generated code (protos, openapi) — include generated artifacts?
carlos: yes if the repo tracks generated files. Run `make gen` or `make gen-protos` and include those diffs, but add a short note like "generated: protos updated". If generated files are large, split into their own PR if possible.
merge-bot: [merge-bot] Reminder: check CODEOWNERS for required reviewers.
anya: approval rules: 1 approval from CODEOWNERS or 2 reviewers. Security-sensitive changes need `@sec-eng`.
maya: merge strategy? squash or keep commits?
carlos: default is squash-and-merge for small fixes. For feature work keep logical commits. If you keep multiple commits, make sure each is meaningful and not a series of "fixup"s.
maya: any PR checklist I should paste?
anya: paste this minimal checklist in the PR body:
```
- [ ] Summary of change
- [ ] Linked ticket: ENG-XXXX
- [ ] How to test locally (commands/env)
- [ ] CI green or explanation for flakes
- [ ] Generated files included (if applicable)
- [ ] Labelled: `area/*`, `type/*`, `size/*`
```
\nmaya: labels we use?
carlos: use `area/runtime|api|infra|docs`, `type/feat|bug|chore`, and `size/xs|s|m|l`. Add `breaking-change` for API or schema changes and `backport-needed` if it affects supported releases.
maya: who should I ping for a quick pass before requesting full reviews?
anya: ping the on-duty reviewer or `@team-runtime` in the PR and add `@anya` if you want a quick review. For docs typos, `@devex` can usually merge quickly.
devex: happy to do a quick pre-review. drop the link here once you open it and we'll skim for style and testing notes.
maya: one more: are there blackout windows to avoid merging big infra changes?
carlos: avoid merging migrations/infra changes right before the main deploy window (10:00 UTC). For anything risky, schedule with infra.
maya: perfect, thanks everyone 10 :heart: I'll open the PR and paste the checklist, pinging `@anya` and `@team-runtime` for reviews.
anya: welcome aboard and congrats on the first change! :tada:
